She wasn’t anxious, she was as happy as a clam when I went to get her. Excellent attention to detail, very impressed with their grooming services! Thank you!

Absolutely loved the service! The grooming was done with great care and attention to detail. The staff was very friendly, professional, and welcoming from the moment we arrived. Customer service was excellent, and the salon was spotless and very clean. My pet looked amazing and seemed comfortable and happy after the appointment. Highly recommend!
I no longer recommend this place.

We used their boarding services and were very satisfied! They are professional and reassuring. Charlie can be anxious when we are not around, but when we picked him up he was relaxed and happy.  We will surely use their services again.
Best service I’ve ever had. The only ones who were able to cut my Dachshund’s nails and their prices are unbeatable. They even gave him some free gifts! The staff is so kind and friendly and patient!

I had such an amazing experience at Choopa Dog Center. From the moment you walk in, you immediately notice how impeccably clean and spotless everything is. It’s clear they truly care about the dogs and the environment they create for them.

What I love most is that they have everything under one roof for your pet’s needs. They carry high-quality products, including one of the best dog foods on the market, Carna4, along with beautiful clothing, toys, and accessories.

The staff are incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and passionate about dogs. The grooming service is amazing — they are patient, gentle, and truly take their time with every dog. My dogs always come out looking absolutely adorable and, most importantly, happy.

They even have a charming Italian café concept which makes the whole experience unique and welcoming.

I would highly recommend Choopa Dog Center to any dog owner looking for a clean, professional, and caring place for their pets. 🐾

Thank you @centrechoopa  Rocky and mom had the best experience. Who knew?! Dog grooming, training, birthday parties, daycare, hotel, food, toys, clothes! Cafe area! WOW 👍🙌👌 First nail cut! Amazing service. A safe haven for animals! It's beautiful and smells great. One stop shop for everything Rocky needs 💙💙💙 …

Amazing staff! They took care in handling and working with our super anxious Maggie! Caring, gentle and professional groomers.  Beautiful boutique! Amazing products from top quality organic Canadian made food to toys, accessories and more. And play area? Simply gorgeous and well thought out!
My dog, Bella gets so excited when she sees Lianna. She just loves to get groomed at Choppa. Thank you for everything 🥰 …

I am literally at a loss of words how impressed I am with this facility and everything they have to offer. The cleanliness is unmatched and the level of service and professionalism and love is incredible. They offer amazing services and everything you need for your dog. It’s a one stop shop and I love that. You can actually hang out with your dog there and bring your children And make a day out of it with their incredible services, cafe, Birthday party options, and even a hotel for your dog to stay. It’s so perfect and gorgeous. I would move in there myself. I am definitely going to be a loyal member of Choopa from today on! Absolutely phenomenal

Brought my morki for a grooming Tuesday and that same night he got sick, diarrhea with blood.  Now he needs meds and antibiotics.  I guess the grooming area wasn't sanitized after an infected dog, as my pup never lives the house perimeter

I just left my handsome Pepe at Choopa for 10 days and I really enjoyed the experience, and so did Pepe! He ate all the kibble I brought, something he never does at other boarding facilities. The staff is very attentive. Their facilities—shop, boarding area, and living spaces—are very clean! It was my first experience and certainly not my last!

I had my 12-year-old Shetland Sheepdog groomed here today.

Irina did a fantastic job. She took her time since my dog ​​is older and even adapted to it, to the point of accepting the comb instead of the brush! It's wonderful; I haven't seen many places that would have made that effort to keep my dog ​​comfortable.

Also, at the last grooming place I went to, they told me my dog ​​was difficult... At Choopa, they told me my dog ​​was great, which shows how attentive they are to the dog's needs, in addition to the scheduled appointment.

A big thank you!

I'll definitely be back.

Beautiful center, the daycare is wonderful and my dog always goes there with so much excitement! The staff are kind and helpful, especially the owner Liana. They also offer different services, including grooming. Highly recommended 🤩❤️ …

I was quite apprehensive about going to Choopa Canine Centre Inc., but even just parking my car, I was pleasantly surprised. The environment was clean (outside), and when I walked in with my lovely Juliette, what a surprise! The store is spotless, the staff are smiling and welcoming, and there's an impressive quantity and selection of toys and accessories for dogs. The area where the dogs play and rest is also very clean and well-organized. I left Juliette there for almost a whole day. She had a grooming appointment during the day. When I went to pick up my dog, she didn't want to leave. She didn't try to escape from the people working at the Canine Centre. For the past two years, I'd had Juliette looked after by another company in Anjou. Juliette wanted to go out and come right back home. We were used to it: while I paid the bill, my partner had to get Juliette into the car. But at Choopa Canine Centre Inc., it was different; she didn't want to leave. So, for me, it's fantastic! An excellent company in St-Léonard/East Montreal. Juliette and I certainly had a wonderful experience and we'd love to repeat it. We highly recommend this company for your dogs.

Thank you, Choopa!

Update: We had our 11-year-old Juliette looked after by Choopa for 23 days. We received regular photos of Juliette during our trip. We found Juliette well-balanced and stress-free; she didn't even want to leave... she definitely loved her place and the staff who took care of her. The team even gave Juliette a bath! Thank you, Choopa! We'll go back anytime and we recommend this company to everyone. Everything is done with the animals' well-being in mind. Thank you to the whole team!
Thank you Masha for your review. We appreciate you very much.

We just discovered Choopa, we knew this would be a great place for our dog. We've tried other places, but got a positive vibe from this beautiful dog haven.  When we met Rosie and her staff, we realized the passion and love they put into it. I highly recommend it.

What a relief! I finally go to a place where they welcome you with open arms, and are completely transparent about where their sweet doggie friends stay and do. Kacey felt calm and at home from the moment we stepped into their place. What an innovative and imaginative space they created for our furry loved ones! Rosie is amazing and ready to help any way she can. Highly recommended!

Thank you for your response, but I need to correct several points:
1.	My dog is a she, not a he – a small but important detail that shows a lack of care and attention to your clients.
2.	It is not a “scratch” – it is a visible cut on the side of her ear that is scabbing, and downplaying it as “just a scratch” is both dismissive and unacceptable.
3.	The only reason we continued to bring our dog to Choopa was because of the specific groomer we trusted. We were never informed that they no longer work there. That lack of communication is extremely unprofessional.

While I appreciate the acknowledgment of her nervousness, your handling of the situation and follow-up has only reinforced that regaining confidence is not an option.

We will not be returning.
